about_the_game:
Embark on the purr-fect expedition to the legendary El Dorado!

A clowder of over 400 curious cats has beaten you to the discovery of the century and scattered themselves across the ancient ruins. Now, it's your mission to find every last one in this massive, charming hidden object game!

Explore Breathtaking Lost Worlds
Immerse yourself in five incredibly detailed, hand-drawn scenes. Uncover the secrets of overgrown Mexican temples, navigate sprawling jungle plazas, and investigate crumbling altars, all brought to life with vibrant colors and ambient sounds.

The Ultimate Hidden Object Challenge
With 80 cunning cats hidden in every level, your observation skills will be put to the test. These feline adventurers have camouflaged themselves perfectly amidst the golden idols, stone carvings, and lush foliage. Can you spot them all?

Key Features:

  • 400 Hidden Cats: A huge and rewarding challenge for hidden object fans.

  • 5 Vast Scenes: Journey through distinct, beautifully rendered environments based on El Dorado and Mesoamerican ruins.

  • Relaxing Gameplay: Perfect to unwind with. No time limits, no pressure—just you and the hunt.

  • Charming & Whimsical: A delightful theme that combines historical mystery with adorable, mischievous cats.

  • Achievements & Collectibles: Prove your expertise as the ultimate explorer.

Sharpen your eyes, click carefully, and help these adventurous cats complete their tour of the lost golden city!
